reviewDoc: Reviewed Phase 5 of RaktoSheba-Frontend (hospital dashboard, commits 21-24). All four commits are present in the git log on main. `npm run build` exits 0 (28 routes compiled, no TypeScript errors) and `npm run lint` exits 0. Checklist: (a) nav-config.ts HOSPITAL array has all 4 items — Overview, Requests, New request, Hospital profile; (b) hospital dashboard page has real 3-column stat cards (Total requests / Open / Fulfilled) backed by live API data, no placeholder; (c) HospitalFilters reads and writes all filter state via URL search params using useSearchParams + router.replace; (d) new-request wizard has exactly 4 steps (blood group → urgency+units → location → review) with per-step validation via trigger(); (e) request detail page includes StatusTimeline via toPublicRequestDetail() adapter and FulfillButton that renders only when status === 'MATCHED'; (f) profile page has HospitalProfileForm (name + address, isDirty guard, verification badge) and LicenceUpload (file type + size validation, raw fetch, view/replace pattern); (g) no new entries in package.json (git diff shows zero changes to the file); (h) all client components open with 'use client' — new-request-wizard.tsx, hospital-filters.tsx, fulfill-button.tsx, hospital-profile-form.tsx, licence-upload.tsx; (i) src/app/actions/hospital.ts opens with 'use server'. No blocking concerns found.
